summary: Verification-only phase independently verifying the 120B Repository Intelligence Prototype Contract before any prototype planning or implementation begins. Verified contract completeness (all 20 required sections present), architectural consistency with the Phase 119 executable schema line (locator vocabulary, uncertainty vocabulary, boundary disclosure fields, and disclaimer constants independently cross-checked byte-for-byte against the schema files, all exact matches) and with Phase 120A (no contradiction found), scope (remains limited to Repository Knowledge Snapshot, read-only, deterministic), input/output models, determinism, read-only boundary (all ten prohibited behaviors confirmed present), attribution, Evidence boundary, uncertainty and limitation contracts, the ten prototype stages (logical ordering confirmed), the fail-closed failure contract, governance compatibility, and sufficiency for 120D-120F without further architectural work. Found one non-blocking terminology clarification (Repository Knowledge Snapshot's actual required field is unknowns, not unknowns_gaps as 120B's prose stated) and one non-blocking structural framing difference (120A's separate Human Review Layer vs. 120B's unified ten-stage list), both documented as guidance for 120D without reopening or modifying the frozen 120B contract. Carried forward the same three known inherited, non-blocking tooling/reporting issues without repairing them. No schema, source, or test file was changed; no implementation occurred.
tests_added_or_updated: None. 120C was a verification-only phase and did not add automated tests.
completeness_assessment: All 20 sections required by the 120B brief are present in the frozen contract document; no required contractual element is missing.
consistency_assessment: No contradiction found between 120B and Phase 119's schema line (locator vocabulary, uncertainty vocabulary, boundary disclosure fields, and disclaimer constants all confirmed exact matches against schema files) or Phase 120A's architecture (every narrowing or reframing is explicit and traceable).
determinism_assessment: The determinism contract (120B Section 6) is precise, testable (byte-for-byte identical output except approved metadata fields), and has no gap allowing non-deterministic behavior; no probabilistic reasoning or AI inference permitted.
governance_compatibility_assessment: The governance contract (120B Section 16) is fully compatible with PCAE's existing governance model; introduces no new mechanism and defers entirely to the lifecycle already in use throughout 118, 119, and 120A-120B.
implementation_readiness_assessment: The frozen contract is sufficient for 120D-120F as written; no additional architectural phase is required before 120D begins. Two non-blocking clarifications were recorded as guidance for 120D (the unknowns field-name detail and the layer-vs-stage framing difference), neither requiring contract modification.
clarifications_found: 120B Section 10 refers to the artifact's 'unknowns_gaps' array; the actual required field name in repository_knowledge_snapshot.schema.json is 'unknowns' (unknowns_gaps is correct for the other seven artifact families, which postdate Repository Knowledge Snapshot's 119O implementation). Non-blocking; 120D must use the schema's actual field name.

120B's ten-stage list (Section 12) folds 120A's separately-described Human Review Layer (120A Section 6) into a unified ten-stage process alongside 120A's nine process stages (120A Section 5). Content is identical; only the structural framing differs. Non-blocking.
